primaries.name: Stitcher
primaries.desc: Rapid vulcan; the spread blooms while held, and hits fade past 30 m

primaries.name: Triplet
primaries.desc: Burst rifle: three hard, accurate rounds a pull, then a beat

primaries.name: Pike
primaries.desc: Accurate rifle with mild bloom and long reach

primaries.name: Gyre
primaries.desc: Rotary cannon: spins up while held, from a chug to a torrent, and runs hot

primaries.name: Squall
primaries.desc: Flak cannon: five slow pellets in a cone, bursting at 60 m

primaries.name: Kiln
primaries.desc: Heat cannon: hold to charge a burning slug that bursts on impact; charging widens the burst from 1 to 3.5 m and speeds the slug

secondaries.name: Dart rack
secondaries.desc: Three fast darts in a tight fan

secondaries.name: Hornet
secondaries.desc: Lock-on volley: middle-click locks the enemy nearest your aim within 30° in 0.35 s, and the lock holds 2.5 s wherever you look; fire four missiles that curve onto it, even round a corner

secondaries.name: Mender
secondaries.desc: Repair beam: hold it on a teammate to mend 10 hp/s, or on an enemy to burn 6 hp/s, out to 28 m; runs warm while held

secondaries.name: Rocket
secondaries.desc: Straight-flying rocket with a 4 m blast

secondaries.name: Spindle
secondaries.desc: Rail rifle: middle-click toggles the scope; let go of the trigger to fire one fast, flat, heavy slug

secondaries.name: Furnace
secondaries.desc: Heat-fed launcher: throws your heat as a fireball, bigger the hotter you run, and fires even overheated

secondaries.name: Mortar
secondaries.desc: Lobbed shell that bounces once or twice, then bursts wide

secondaries.name: Splitter
secondaries.desc: Cluster canister: bursts at its fuse or on a second press into six bomblets that rain down

secondaries.name: Warren
secondaries.desc: Mine layer: three sticky mines that burst when an enemy comes within 3.5 m; six down at most
